paysim_model_on_ieee_data.note: Cross-domain test: PaySim-trained model evaluated with no retraining.

fresh_model_trained_on_ieee.note: Separately trained and evaluated on IEEE-CIS's own held-out split.

domain_mismatch_caveat: IEEE-CIS is card/e-commerce fraud data, not peer-to-peer transfer fraud like PaySim/UPI. 'is_new_recipient' and 'payments_last_hour' are approximated from card1 (card identifier), not a true recipient -- see this script's docstring.
